findings.summary: crates/app/src/main.rs:78-84 (wasm get): no test covers the expired-login path. Removing init.set_redirect(Manual) leaves every test passing: the wasm code is cfg'd out of the native tests. In the browser that mutant showed 'JsValue(TypeError: Failed to fetch ...)' instead of the expired-login message (mut-shots/mut-crop.png). I saw the behaviour work only in Chromium against a stand-in edge.

Carried from round 1 and still true: no test checks that the public router doesn't serve /metrics. The metrics_on_public mutant passes every server test (mutations.log). Live, the public port gave 401 without a token and 404 with one.

Carried from round 1: the native app refused by Access, or with the login expired, follows the redirect to the login page and shows 'expected value at line 1 column 1'. It doesn't say that access was refused (shots/05-app-none.png, 05-app-none-expiredmode.png). There's still no test for sending CF-Access-Client-Id/Secret or for the one-of-two check.

.github/workflows/ci.yaml image job: on a push to main that touches only docs/ (not paths-ignored), CI rebuilds and pushes :latest. Locally, two builds from the same context had identical layers and amd64 manifest, but the OCI index digest differed (sha256:6690e33f... vs ff9b1b18...). Only the provenance attestation manifest changed (context.log). If build-push-action attaches provenance in CI, Image Updater would see a new :latest digest and roll out an identical image after a docs-only merge. Only the registry and cluster can show it. Also, .github/, README.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/ and board.toml are still in the build context, so changes there change it.

deploy/values.yaml: access.issuer and access.aud are still empty. `helm template sdlc-board deploy` with the committed values fails with 'access.issuer: the Access team URL' (helm.log), so CI's deploy job fails until they're filled in, as the ticket notes say. I didn't run kubeconform: its downloads are blocked here.

Only the cluster can show these, and I didn't exercise them: real Cloudflare Access login, expiry redirect and service-token policy; the tunnel and board.trulinc.com route; the ArgoCD sync; Image Updater's write-back and the paths-ignore that stops the loop; the GHCR push and pull; the ServiceMonitor; the NetworkPolicy. The Android build is TRU-13.
